assets.name: interior-gamazine-gold
assets.prompt: Create a NEW premium architectural photograph of an INTERIOR WALL finished in warm sandy-gold Gamazine-style decorative coating, using the attached example only as reference for the coating. The wall must show unmistakable dense irregular dragged and curled mineral aggregate ridges, the same pronounced rough textured finish seen on the reference walls. NOT normal smooth wall paint, not subtle roller texture, not marble or smooth plaster. Close oblique architectural view of a wide wall and its interior corner, with a sliver of adjoining ivory textured wall and crisp white skirting at bottom to show scale. Textured wall fills 90% of image. Soft raking natural daylight reveals depth of every raised grain and swirl. High-end, clean professional workmanship and refined warm colour. No furniture, plants, books, art, decor, people or paint cans. Landscape 1536x1024, photorealistic architectural editorial photography, single image, no words or watermarks.
